\section{Floats in two columns}\label{sec:floats}

A float carries its caption once, and the \emph{emitted} form stays plain so an
edit made in the LaTeX comes back as prose.

\begin{table}[!t]
\caption{What the float renderers map, and the markdown each construct is written as.}
\label{tab:floats}
\centering
\footnotesize
\begin{tabularx}{\columnwidth}{>{\hsize=0.605\hsize\raggedright\arraybackslash}X >{\hsize=1.096\hsize\raggedright\arraybackslash}X >{\hsize=1.299\hsize\raggedright\arraybackslash}X}
\toprule
Construct & Written as & Renders to \\
\midrule
Figure & an image block with an identifier & a figure float carrying caption and label \\
Table & a pipe table and a caption line & a tabularx float at the measure its content needs \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabularx}
\end{table}
